en: Black‑and‑white rural scene in a mountainous valley. In the foreground stands a small log cabin with a sod/grass roof; a woman and a child are in the doorway, and other women and children stand nearby. A cow grazes beside the hut. Scattered wooden farm buildings and fields stretch across the valley, backed by forested hills. At the very top right is a printed archival number "MINØ.43841". At the bottom, handwritten text reads something like a place name.
